lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the pectoral fin, arranged in a semi-regular grid with consistent vertical spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, with the highest-intensity blobs positioned as nodes within these vertical linear features.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge, extending from above the gills toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of small, high-luminance circular blobs scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration along the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora-like organism is visible in the ventral-lateral region beneath the primary pectoral fin.
